methods: SHA-256 comparison against every published source asset and matching master-file copies
PDF page counts, embedded metadata and normalized per-page text comparison
Archival OCR cross-check for scanned PDFs, followed by rendered-page visual verification
Full-page review of every retained record, including split-page oversight tables
Cross-document and within-document normalized page-text comparison to disclose reused appendices without treating materially distinct records as duplicates
Rendered review of image-only O&M manual excerpts and blank trailing pages in the MAHL packages
Whole-document five-word shingle comparison to detect same-content PDFs whose pagination or export formatting changed
Row-by-row semantic comparison of the Submissions CSV after parsing dates and fields
Rendered side-by-side review of high-overlap revisions and same-template industrial-user forms

decisions.name: Cadillac WWTP IPP 2011.pdf
decisions.reason: Suppressed from Category 04 because its SHA-256 hash exactly matches the 50-page source already published in Category 02. The existing source remains available and is linked from the event trace.

decisions.name: Cadillac WWTP SIU Information.pdf
decisions.reason: Retained. It is a distinct 11-page scanned SIU packet; OCR was treated as an aid and the Wexford sheet was verified from the rendered page.

decisions.name: Pre-Inspection Report.pdf
decisions.reason: Retained. This is the seven-page 2015 Pretreatment Compliance Inspection 57515, not the different 2014 pre-inspection report already used in the timeline.

decisions.name: 2018_POTW_Oversight_Table.pdf and 2019_POTW_Oversight_Table.pdf
decisions.reason: Retained as separate annual records. Their byte hashes, normalized text hashes, metadata dates and reporting-cycle contents differ.

decisions.name: 2019_SIU-CIU_List.pdf
decisions.reason: Retained as a distinct six-page facility and contact inventory, not a copy of either annual oversight table.

decisions.name: December 2024 MAHL report and March 2025 EGLE review package
decisions.reason: Retained as materially distinct records. The 204-page March package contains an agency-review email, a revised January 2025 report and supporting material; 122 of its normalized pages match pages in the standalone 131-page December report, and pages 101-148 repeat internally as pages 153-200. Exact master copies found under the Duplicates folder were not republished. Image-only O&M excerpts were visually verified; the March package's final four pages are blank.

decisions.name: Category 04 loose-file and ZIP batch
decisions.reason: Reviewed 310 PDF copies representing 171 byte-distinct hashes. One hundred thirty-nine exact duplicate copies were collapsed, 20 hashes already published elsewhere were not republished, two additional byte-different PDFs with identical normalized text were collapsed, and 149 materially distinct PDFs were retained.

decisions.name: RE_ Cadillac MAHL revisions and Cadillac Casting Meeting resaves
decisions.reason: One resaved copy in each pair had the same complete normalized text as its cleaner-named counterpart. Only the cleaner display record was retained.

decisions.name: Email, submittal and report attachment relationships
decisions.reason: Thirty-three exact page-overlap relationships were documented. A report embedded in a later email or submittal package was not treated as a duplicate of the entire container; revisions with changed values or additional messages were also retained.

decisions.name: Image-only and low-text PDFs
decisions.reason: Twenty image-only PDFs and nine additional PDFs with low-text pages were rendered and reviewed. Similar-looking affidavits and dental forms were different years, facilities or contents; none was suppressed as a scanned duplicate.

decisions.name: 09-23-2025 - Submissions.csv
decisions.reason: Not republished. Its 15 rows and seven fields match the existing Submissions.csv dataset; only the timestamp display format differs.

decisions.name: Copy-style filename labels
decisions.reason: Retained records are displayed under clean provenance names. Copy-number labels were removed from display names when the underlying record proved distinct; revised/final labels were kept only when they describe substantive document status.

decisions.name: GitHub-backed document delivery
decisions.reason: The 149 retained PDFs are preserved in the authorized BLAXWATER/cadillac-pfas-event-trace repository and open there from the Site. The original seven Category 04 PDFs remain bundled with Sites. This split avoids Sites' 256 MiB expanded-archive limit without dropping a record or changing a source file.

decisions.name: 08-26-2021 Cadillac WWTP IPP Compliance Inspection Report.pdf
decisions.reason: Retained as a distinct 19-page EGLE IPP inspection record. Its date, inspection period, page count, normalized text and content differ from the seven-page 2015 pretreatment pre-inspection report already in the library.
